title: The Armorer
description: Working to keep the more orthodox version of the Mandalorian culture alive, the Armorer led a covert of adherents, including Din Djarin. She forged armor and weapons of beskar on a forge in the ancient Mandalorian fashion, using magnetic tongs and a gravity hammer that could double as a weapon. Though zealous in her religion, her beliefs shifted enough to work with Bo-Katan to reclaim their home.
